dedupe_keys.name: cross border public transport routes and services in eu border regions

description: This dataset maps the routes of cross-border public transport services in the EU together with timetables, in GTFS format, of the services running on them. The interactive map shows ferry ports and services, rail stations and services, bus stops and services and tram stops and services, both across borders and within border areas, with layers for all cross-border services, border permeability and the number of cross-border services per country, against 25 km and extended border regions. It was produced for a DG REGIO study of public transport in border regions and is published by the European Commission's Directorate-General for Regional and Urban Policy. Coverage is the internal land and sea borders of the EU. Access: a free ZIP of geodata and GTFS timetables and an online ArcGIS-based map, under the European Commission reuse notice. Caveats: the download was last modified in February 2023, so it is a snapshot of services at the time of the study. It supports accessibility and network flow analysis across borders, disruption studies of cross-border links and planning of cross-border services, and complements the Mobility Database and the EU TEN-T network catalogued here.
